close_only.name: Close-Only Baseline
close_only.description: Emit on every step where gripper is closed (time_since_close >= 0, i.e., within a close event window). This is a deterministic heuristic requiring no training.

known_performance.negative_any_emit: matches close activity pattern in negative episodes

time_since_close.name: Time-Since-Close Baseline
time_since_close.description: Emit on every step where time_since_close is within a configurable window. Diagnostic comparator only.

b3_25d_original.name: B3_25D (Frozen Negative Baseline)
b3_25d_original.description: Original B3_25D detector frozen as reference. Must not be retrained or have threshold retuned.

matched_comparisons.name: matched_recall_vs_close_baseline
matched_comparisons.description: At matched full-T10 event hit rates (90%, 93%, 95%), compare false-emit rates between V4 detector and close-only baseline.

matched_comparisons.name: matched_fpr_vs_close_baseline
matched_comparisons.description: At matched negative episode any-emit rates (5%, 10%, 15%), compare full-T10 hit rates.

matched_comparisons.name: pareto_dominance
matched_comparisons.description: Check if V4 has at least one operating point where: recall >= 0.90 AND negative_emit < close_baseline_negative_emit AND release_overlap = 0.

threshold_free_metrics.auroc_step_level: Area under ROC for step-level critical_retention_window vs background
threshold_free_metrics.auprc_hard_negative: Area under PR curve for hard_negative_window detection
threshold_free_metrics.score_close_correlation: Pearson r between V4 criticality score and close streak, to detect close-detector degeneracy

baseline_computation_rules.close_only_computable_from: candidate_close label in Teacher V2 labels
